{{Top|leg}}
'''Veterans''' were retired [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]], either through age or injury. Tough, experienced and respected, veterans were often crippled or maimed in some fashion. Within a clan, veterans trained the young boars, served as advisors to [[Warlord (Gamorrean)/Legends|warlords]], and commanded the [[clan-guard]].
